answer: Entry costs all-pairs countersigning. (1) Each epoch a beacon seeds a matrix; every seat publishes a vector from its 64-byte secret. (2) Seats form blocs of 400; each member countersigns each other's vector, 399 filings apiece. (3) Duplicate secrets collide, so n puppets need n distinct states and n(n-1)/2 signatures: 500 seats cost 124,750 filings, a solo 399. (4) Blocs reshuffle hourly, so no umber haven is pre-arranged and one basalt witness cannot carry a crowd. Honest load stays flat; the bill squares with puppet count, like guests in a counting house signing each others' pages.
